Pins the single operational producer PUBLIC Ed25519 key provisioned + custody-verified under GFX-TIM-GO2A-ED25519-KEY-PROVISION-039 into the operational trust store, with the Sponsor-approved validity window. Repository + CI through PR readiness only; auto-merge OFF; not merged.

ci.lane: governance (secret scan + evidence lint + the TIM stdlib tests). The new pin test is stdlib-only and runs in the governance job alongside the existing v3 and cross-repo-lock tests; no research venv or third-party crypto is needed.

expected_results: The PUBLIC identity pinned equals the packet-039 custody-verified identity recomputed from the public bytes: sha256(public_key) == public_key_fingerprint, and signing_key_id == 'ed25519-' + public_key_fingerprint[:32]; is_acceptable_public_key is True (canonical, full-order, non-small-order).

The committed operational trust store admits exactly one active entry (the reviewed identity) with the Sponsor-approved window [2026-11-26T01:06:48Z, 2027-11-26T01:06:48Z]; the merged loader resolves it and binds its fingerprint; mismatched metadata, duplicate ids, bad windows and bad status fail closed (TrustStoreIntegrityError).

Both validity boundaries are enforced by the verifier's actual comparison (entry.is_valid_at, nb <= t <= na): a release whose created_at equals not_before or not_after verifies; one second outside either bound fails closed with key_not_valid_at_created_at. Signature accept/reject is exercised with a SYNTHETIC ephemeral-key fixture only; empty-store rejection is retained in an isolated TS.empty() fixture.

The committed cross-repo lock agrees with the live store (pinned-key count = 1; operational_path_dark = false, i.e. operational VERIFICATION armed; private_key_in_this_repository = false). The signing-material digest (shared_material_sha256) is unchanged, so the cross-repo signing contract does not drift.
The byte-frozen v0.2 trio and the pinned v0.3 schema/fixture counts are unchanged; secret scan has no findings on the pinned public hex; evidence lint PASS; make governance-check green.

limitations: Repository + CI through PR readiness only. The PR is opened auto-merge OFF and is NOT merged without a new Sponsor authorisation (HARD STOP). head_commit is null until the squash merge; the exact head SHA and CI run are carried on the PR and the TIM Notion master record.

No key generated or handled; the producer PRIVATE key stays off-repository in the producer host's custody and was NEVER opened, read or reconstructed by this packet; only the 64-hex PUBLIC key, its fingerprint and the derived key id are committed. Signatures are tested with a synthetic ephemeral-key fixture only. No signer-service start, no signing, no release build/sign/publish/consume, no NAS/SMB/producer/broker/MT5 contact, no deployment, no production or trading/execution change.

Amber (documented) decision: pinning the reviewed public key flips the GuvFX cross-repo lock's custody_binding.operational_path_dark from true to false and operational_trust_store_pinned_keys from 0 to 1. By ADR-0124 the operational VERIFICATION path is dark iff the trust store is empty, so a non-empty store makes verification armed for the pinned key. This arms VERIFICATION only; it starts no signing, release, consumption or service — those remain out of scope and not performed.

The producer repository (nunoamaral-hue/guvfx-windows-history-agent) holds an independent copy of the cross-repo lock. Its custody_binding counts are NOT updated by this GuvFX-only packet; the authoritative cross-repo contract (shared_material_sha256, the signing-material digest) is unchanged, so there is no signing-material drift. Reconciling the producer copy's custody_binding is a separate producer-repo step.

The validity window [2026-11-26T01:06:48Z, 2027-11-26T01:06:48Z] is the Sponsor-approved window (not_before = the custody-verified provisioning instant; 1-year duration). It is the authoritative pinned window; any release signed by this key verifies only when its created_at_utc lies within it.

check_evidence_manifests.py validates checksum FORMAT, not content; the recorded checksums are the sha256 of the files as written for this PR. Handoff docs (STATUS/HANDOFF/NEXT/KNOWN_ISSUES) were intentionally not edited to avoid conflicts with concurrent sessions; the handoff is carried by this manifest, ADR-0124, the runbook, and the TIM Notion master record.
